Class ReliablePacketManager

java.lang.Object
com.quietterminal.neon.core.ReliablePacketManager
public final class ReliablePacketManager extends Object
Provides opt-in reliable delivery for game packets with correct sequence wrap-around handling.

Tracks outbound packets waiting for ACK, retransmits on timeout with exponential back-off, and deduplicates inbound packets per sender using signed 16-bit sequence arithmetic — correctly handling the 65535 → 0 wrap-around.

Call processRetransmissions() periodically (e.g. from the host processing loop) to drive retransmit and failure logic.

    • ReliablePacketManager

      public ReliablePacketManager(NeonSocket socket, SocketAddress destination, byte clientId, NeonConfig config)
      Creates a new manager that sends and receives through the given socket.
      Parameters:
      socket - the UDP socket to use for sends and ACKs
      destination - the remote address to send packets to
      clientId - this endpoint's client ID, included in ACK headers
      config - supplies reliablePacketTimeoutMs and reliablePacketMaxRetries

    • processRetransmissions

      public void processRetransmissions() throws IOException
      Checks all pending packets for timeout. Retransmits those within the retry budget; removes and fires setOnDeliveryFailed(Consumer) for those that have exhausted retries.
      Throws:
      IOException - if a retransmit send fails

    • isDuplicate

      public boolean isDuplicate(byte senderId, short sequence)
      Returns true if sequence is a duplicate from senderId. Uses signed 16-bit subtraction to handle the 65535 → 0 wrap-around correctly. Updates the last-seen sequence for the sender on non-duplicate packets.
      Parameters:
      senderId - the originating client ID
      sequence - the packet sequence number to check

    • sendAckFor

      public void sendAckFor(short sequence) throws IOException
      Sends an PacketPayload.Ack for the given sequence number. Uses an internal counter for the ACK packet's own sequence number.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the send fails
